title: German Bratwurst Burger
description: A twist on the classic burger, featuring a German bratwurst sausage sandwiched between a toasted bun, topped with a slice of cheese and sauerkraut.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Cook the bratwurst sausages for 5-7 minutes on each side, until nicely browned and cooked through.
3. Meanwhile, toast the buns on the grill or in a toaster.
4. Assemble the burgers by spreading a slice of cheese on the bottom bun, followed by a cooked bratwurst sausage, a spoonful of sauerkraut, and finally the top bun.
5. Optional: Top with a ground beef patty and a slice of cheese.
6. Serve immediately, garnished with thinly sliced onion and crusty bread on the side.
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
